Values that may mark rows without f0 in an f0 column in Hz

Source: R/gaps.R
suggest_unvoiced.Rd

Some pitch trackers write 0, or a value such as -1, for frames where they found no f0. zero_hz_to_na() reads 0 as NA only in the columns it recognises as Hz, so a column such as f0_rapt can keep its 0s. This looks at the values of one column and returns those that probably mark no f0, to pass to the unvoiced argument of screen_f0_rows() and drop_rows_without_f0(). The app's Start page offers to read them as no f0. screen_f0_rows() also reports them, with their row counts.

Usage

suggest_unvoiced(x)

Arguments

x

A vector of f0 values. A factor is read by its labels, and text through as.numeric(), so labels such as "--undefined--" are ignored.

Value

A numeric vector of the values that may mark no f0, such as c(0, -1), or NULL when there are none.

Details

A column looks like Hz when the median of its positive values is 30 to 2000, and it has no negative values apart from one value that occurs more than once, such as -1. In such a column, 0 and that negative value are returned, 0 first.

Nothing is returned (NULL) for:

  • a signed or normalised column, such as semitones or z-scores: it has several different negative values, or a median outside 30 to 2000;

  • a column with a single negative value. One value cannot be told from a real one, so the column is not taken for Hz, and its 0s are not offered either;

  • a column with no 0 and no negative marker.

The check looks only at the values. A scale that is never negative but is not Hz, such as cents above each speaker's lowest f0, can have its 0s returned too, although they are real values there. Use this on columns in Hz only.

See also

screen_f0_rows() and drop_rows_without_f0(), whose unvoiced argument takes these values; zero_hz_to_na().

Examples

# 0 and -1 for unvoiced frames
suggest_unvoiced(c(0, 0, 182.5, 190.1, -1, -1, 201.3))
#> [1]  0 -1
# A column zero_hz_to_na() has already read: nothing left to offer
suggest_unvoiced(c(NA, NA, 182.5, 190.1, 201.3))
#> NULL
# Semitones: 0 and negative values are real f0
suggest_unvoiced(c(-2.5, 0, 1.2, -0.3, 3.1, 0))
#> NULL

df <- data.frame(token = "a", time = 0.005 + 0.01 * (0:5),
                 f0_rapt = c(0, 150, 152, 0, 155, 0))
unv <- suggest_unvoiced(df$f0_rapt)
drop_rows_without_f0(df, f0 = "f0_rapt", unvoiced = unv)
#>   token  time f0_rapt voiced_run
#> 1     a 0.015     150          1
#> 2     a 0.025     152          1
#> 3     a 0.045     155          2
